assumptions.commission: Experiment assumptions, not the user's broker tariff; includes exchange/regulatory fees; transfer fee is separate.
assumptions.slippage: 5 bps adverse to raw opening price, rounded against the order to the instrument tick.
assumptions.liquidity: Explicit opening capacity with observed/assumed origin is required. Daily total volume is never opening liquidity.
assumptions.fills: Full quantity or no fill, one supplied target opening session only; no rollover, intraday fills or queue simulation.
assumptions.rounding: Notional and each fee component independently round half-up to CNY 0.01.
assumptions.classification: Caller supplies verified instrument class and dated session facts; no automatic ST/IPO/ETF classification.
